findings.title: Sends 100% of a treasury account (153.6M MNDE) to an address this DAO has never paid
findings.explanation: Sends 153,600,023.54 MNDE (~153.6M) from DAO MNDE account GR1L…xgSi — that is 100% of that treasury account and 50% of all MNDE held by this DAO — to 3Pvi…1qsW (a MNDE account owned by EwH7…TPQA). This DAO has never paid this address before.

findings.title: Sends 100% of a treasury account (36.1M MNDE) to an address this DAO has never paid
findings.explanation: Sends 36,116,209.36 MNDE (~36.1M) from DAO MNDE account G5Ax…eY2v — that is 100% of that treasury account and 12% of all MNDE held by this DAO — to 3Pvi…1qsW (a MNDE account owned by EwH7…TPQA). This DAO has never paid this address before.

findings.title: Sends 100% of a treasury account (29.83 mSOL) to an address this DAO has never paid
findings.explanation: Sends 29.83 mSOL (~29.83) from DAO mSOL account iitf…4NE6 — that is 100% of that treasury account and 97% of all mSOL held by this DAO — to Dwsu…4Zpv (a mSOL account owned by EwH7…TPQA). This DAO has never paid this address before.

findings.title: In total this proposal sends 189.7M MNDE out of the DAO
findings.explanation: 2 instructions (#1, #2) together send 189,716,232.89 MNDE out of the DAO — 62% of all MNDE held by this DAO.

findings.title: Dangerous actions execute instantly (hold-up time 0)
findings.explanation: Instructions #1, #2, #3 can be executed the moment voting ends — hold-up time is 0, so nobody has time to react (withdraw funds, alert the council) if the vote is won by an attacker. This governance's minimum hold-up time is 0 (executes immediately).

findings.title: The description does not match what the proposal does
findings.explanation: Description says: 'Consolidate DAO treasury token accounts and fund approved operational budgets'. Actually: moves 153.6M MNDE (100% of a treasury account) to 3Pvi…1qsW, an address this DAO has never paid; moves 36.1M MNDE (100% of a treasury account) to 3Pvi…1qsW, an address this DAO has never paid; moves 29.83 mSOL (100% of a treasury account) to Dwsu…4Zpv, an address this DAO has never paid. The description names neither the amount nor the recipient of these transfers.

findings.title: The description does not match what the proposal does
findings.explanation: Description says: 'Consolidate DAO treasury token accounts and fund approved operational budgets'. Actually: all 3 transfers send funds out of the DAO, to a wallet the DAO does not control (EwH7…TPQA). Consolidating would move funds between DAO-owned accounts; these destinations are not owned by the DAO.
